title: RDX Approval v1
description: Canonical schema for an individual Cat-4 approval artifact, committed to _bmad/rdx/approvals/<diff_digest>.json (B1 in-repo JSON storage). The file name binds the approval to a specific diff via diff_digest — any diff change orphans the file and the validator re-blocks.

rule_id.description: Identifier of the rule being approved (e.g. RP-UNSAFE-001, GOV-KB-001). Must match a rule emitted by the validator for this diff.

approver_identity.description: Approver email or @-prefixed GitHub handle. Validator verifies it appears in approvers.yaml under the role named below.

approver_role.description: Role from approvers.yaml. Validator confirms identity ∈ role.identities.

head_sha.description: Commit SHA the approval was issued against. Audit field; the diff_digest is the actual binding.

diff_digest.description: SHA-256 (or stronger) digest of the diff this approval covers. MUST equal the file's basename stem in _bmad/rdx/approvals/<diff_digest>.json.

conditions.description: Free-text justification or conditions attached to the decision.

signature.description: Reserved for Phase 9 HA: HMAC / detached signature over the approval body. NOT required in V6.
